data.summary: Eaton's AI positioning is implicit rather than explicit. The company emphasizes intelligent power management and data center solutions which are foundational to AI infrastructure, particularly through acquisitions enabling chip-to-grid solutions. The strategic focus on hyperscale data centers and AI-ready cooling solutions (Boyd Thermal acquisition) positions Eaton as an infrastructure enabler for AI workloads. Direct AI mentions are limited in the 10-K, but the acquisition strategy and capability buildout clearly target the infrastructure requirements of AI systems.
evidence: Boyd Thermal acquisition described as enabling 'chip to the grid' solutions for hyperscale and colocation customers
